title: Tech Note: SQL Data Types in 4D v11 SQL
author: Chris Visaya, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: 4D v11 SQL Data Definition Language (CREATE TABLE)
SQL-to-4D type mapping (VARCHAR, TEXT, CLOB, NUMERIC, TIMESTAMP, DURATION, etc.)
4D field types (Text, Real, Integer, Longint, Boolean, BLOB, Picture, Date/Time, Time)

historical_commentary.text: This note documented how 4D v11 SQL's newly introduced SQL Data Definition Language mapped standard SQL column types onto 4D's native field types, a genuinely useful reference at a time when SQL-based structure creation was new to 4D developers. This type-mapping information is still accurate and still relevant today, since 4D's SQL engine and its underlying field type system have remained fundamentally the same, though ORDA-based entity models built on the classic structure are now often the preferred way to model and access data (SQL DDL/DML being more of an alternate/legacy access path in mature projects).
related_updates: ORDA (4D v16 R5+, 2017) is now the primary recommended way to model and query 4D data, with SQL representing an alternate access path that remains fully functional
The SQL-to-4D type mappings documented here remain accurate in current 4D versions
